{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string with commas to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("Sentinel values in customer_age (should be -1 for missing):", sales_df['customer_age'].unique())

# Check for duplicates
print("Number of duplicate rows:", sales_df.duplicated().sum())

# Check the distribution of channels and customer segments
print("Channel distribution:\n", sales_df['channel'].value_counts())
print("Customer segment distribution:\n", sales_df['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Check status
print("Status distribution:\n", sales_df['status'].value_counts())

# Check if there are any refunded orders
refunded_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'refunded']
print("Number of refunded orders:", len(refunded_orders))"}
